item.title: n2-002 - Breakfast or lunch
item.description: 课前问题 be+doing vs do/does 感叹句？ 如何确定频率副词 adv. 的位置？ Always (100%) → Usually → Often/Frequently → Sometimes → Occasionally → Rarely/Seldom → Hardly ever → Never (0%) 课文 It was Sunday. I never get up early on Sundays. I sometimes stay in bed until lunch time. Last Sunday, I got up very late. I looked out of the window. It’s dark outside.

item.title: 现在进行时表示当前阶段状态
item.description: 表示最近一段时间的状态, 但是不一定是现在正在发生。 He’s driving very fast these days. I’m working on a new project there days.
